description: This file defines a class 'BinaryProtocolCmd' with a method to check for the existence of a specific definition file and show a dialog if not found.

classes.name: BinaryProtocolCmd
classes.description: A utility class providing a method to verify the existence of a configuration definition file.

methods.name: checkForDefinitionFile
methods.description: Checks if the definition file specified by 'RomRaiderWrapper.DEFINITION_FILE' exists; shows a dialog if not, and returns false. Otherwise, returns true.
